name: @rune-design/mcp
description: MCP server that gives AI agents full read-write access to Figma

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --external '@modelcontextprotocol/*' --external 'zod' --external 'sharp' && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.writeFileSync('dist/index.js','#!/usr/bin/env bun\n'+f.readFileSync('dist/index.js','utf8'))" && chmod +x dist/index.js
